summary.text: Danny Mathis was elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in 2018, was sworn in on January 14, 2019, and represents District 133.

paragraphs.text: Mathis is a lifelong resident of Cochran, graduated from Cochran High School in 1972, and is a graduate of Middle Georgia College (associate's degree in business administration) and the Gupton-Jones College of Funeral Service.
Mathis owns and operates Mathis Funeral Home in Cochran and previously served as Bleckley County coroner for 18 years.
